name: DM-Ready Audience Builder
subtitle: Build a clean, DM-able audience from any post or public X list.
summary: Collects everyone who replied to, quoted, or reposted a post, or the members of a public X list (not likers, not followers), filters to people with open DMs plus any bio keyword or follower filters, and saves the result as a dataset ready for a campaign now or later. You can download it or add people to your contacts, up to 500 per card.
howToAsk: Grab the members of this X list: [link]
Who from this list has open DMs?
provide: the post or public X list link, plus any filters.
get: a filtered dataset with counts, a download, add-to-contacts up to 500 per card, and a path to a campaign.
chips: Over 100 people runs in the background
launchPrompt: Build me a DM-ready audience from this post or public X list: [paste link]. Keep only people with open DMs, and also filter by: [bio keyword, minimum followers, or leave blank for none].
